about: Factor rows that are loaded but WITHHELD: kept in the database for traceability, never selected (is_active = False), so the activity is reported as "not calculated — factor under review". A row is released by removing its slug from this file once its mapping, density or method is individually resolved and approved, then re-running the seed commands. Do not release a row for any other reason. Review: audit/stage7/.

air-freight.reason: "With RF" rows mapped while DR-09 is undecided; tm-07 / tm-07-short also use "to/from UK" routes, and DEFRA has no short-haul freight row for non-UK routes.

biodiesel.reason: DEFRA publishes several biodiesels: ME 0.16751 and HVO 0.03558 kg/l. The catalogue value 0.03639 is close to HVO, not to the ME row that was mapped. Biodiesel type and boundary are not stated (DR-12).

bioethanol.reason: Item name matches the DEFRA row, but the catalogue value differs 3x from it in either direction and the intended boundary (biogenic CO2 excluded / total) is an open decision (DR-12).

coal.reason: Generic / Turkish "Coal/Lignite" mapped to UK "Coal (industrial)" (NCV 25.4 GJ/t, sheet Fuel properties D22). Turkish lignite has a far lower calorific value (IPCC default 11.9 TJ/Gg, Table 1.2), so the UK row can overstate lignite by roughly a factor of two.

diesel-kwh.reason: Catalogue name is "Diesel (kWh)" but the cited and mapped row is "Gas oil", gross CV. Fuel identity (diesel vs gas oil) and CV basis of a diesel kWh figure are not established; DR-17 is open.

district-heating.reason: UK "District heat and steam": the fuel mix of UK heat networks (DUKES 1/3:2/3 method, methodology 2026 para 3.29). Not transferable to a Turkish heat or steam supplier.

flight-domestic.reason: Three open points. (1) "With RF" rows were mapped; the owner's documented practice is WITHOUT RF (register D-AIR-SHORT-NORF) and DR-09 is undecided. (2) "to/from UK" rows describe UK routes; DEFRA provides "International, to/from non-UK" for flights between other countries (methodology 2026 para 8.10). (3) DEFRA haul classes are defined by territory relative to the UK (sheet Haul definition; Turkey = Short Haul, C219), not by the km bands of the catalogue (<500 / 500-3700 / >3700 km).

flight-international.reason: Route class is right ("International, to/from non-UK"), but the "With RF" row was mapped while DR-09 (RF or not) is undecided and the owner's documented practice is without RF.

fuel-extraction.reason: Generic "fuel extraction and processing per litre" mapped to the WTT row of diesel. Documented by the owner for diesel only (register D-WTT-DIESEL); DEFRA has a separate WTT row per fuel (petrol 0.58094). Applying the diesel row to other fuels is unsupported.

gasoline-generic.reason: Mapped to "Petrol (average biofuel blend)" (2.075 kg/l), which embeds the UK E10 ethanol share. The "100% mineral petrol" row is 2.354 (13% higher) and the owner's 2024 table gives 2.350 (D24-PETROL-ON). No evidence which blend fits Turkey.

general-landfill.reason: Mapped to "Commercial and industrial waste, landfill" (520.6 kg/t). The owner's document uses "Household residual waste, landfill" (497.3 kg/t; register D-WASTE-LANDFILL) and DR-13(c) holds the choice until the waste category is declared.

metro.reason: UK "Light rail and tram": driven almost entirely by the UK grid factor (0.131 kg/kWh in 2026, against 0.44-0.48 for Türkiye). Applying it to a Turkish metro understates by a large factor.

train.reason: UK "National rail": a mix of diesel and UK-grid electric traction with UK occupancy. Not transferable to another country's railway; DEFRA itself limits its factors to UK activity (methodology 2026 para 1.4-1.5).

transmission-losses.reason: Generic T&D loss factor mapped to the UK grid T&D row. DR-06 decided T&D stays unchanged; a UK grid value must not stand for another country's network.

truck-delivery.reason: Mapped to "All HGVs, average laden" per tonne-km. DR-01 (tonne-km and vehicle-km are separate methods) is undecided; the owner's document uses rigid HGVs per vehicle-km (register D-HGV-KM) and the Turkish catalogue row stores that per-km value under a tonne-km unit.
